overview: The High Court is the apex of Seru’s judicial hierarchy. All final judgements, doctrinal rulings, and purity sentences originate here.
history: Founded during the earliest consolidation of Seru’s imperial rule.
Arcane adjudication chambers were added to stabilize decree magic.
Purity‑screened courtrooms were introduced to prevent ideological corruption.
Praetorian magistrate halls were integrated to enforce doctrinal rulings.
hooks: A verdict pylon destabilizes during a high‑profile trial.
A purity courtroom reports a corrupted decree signature.
A Praetorian magistrate requests assistance with a sealed Tribunal case.
